predecessors.name: Kingdom of Armenia
predecessors.text: Sophene, the Orontid lands round Arsamosata

ledger.x: c. 95: Tigranes the Great conquers Sophene. Infobox 'Conquered: c. 95 BCE, by Tigranes the Great of Greater Armenia'; he 'deposed Artanes', the last king (the Tigranes page: accession 96/95, no date for Sophene).

wars.name: Antiochus III's campaign against Xerxes of Sophene
wars.outcome: Xerxes submitted and married Antiochus's sister Antiochis; later sources say she poisoned him on Antiochus's orders.

wars.name: Rebellion of Zariadres and Artaxias against the Seleucids
wars.outcome: After Magnesia Zariadres took the royal title; under the Treaty of Apamea (188) Antiochus III gave up the lands north and west of the Taurus, 'which included Sophene and Greater Armenia'.

wars.name: Tigranes the Great's conquest of Sophene
wars.outcome: Tigranes deposed Artanes, the last king, c.

certainty.note: The page describes Sophene by its neighbours (Acilisene to the north, Akisene to the west, the Taurus to the south under Apamea) and gives no treaty line; every frontier is soft.
